Angel,Ⓒs.ⒹdevadUtaH, ISvaraprezyaH, svargadUtaH, ‘you are my a(ngel)’ tvaM me priyatamA, prARapreyasI.

Ⓝ[Angl]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹmatsyagrahaRaM.
